Concept geometry of CL-05 (tools/cad/b3d/cl05.py). Postures between the analysed ones and the walk are concept kinematics: no dynamics, balance or load model.
Terms: 1A–4F = risk assessment code, severity 1–4 plus probability A–F (e.g. 1C) · 3D = three-dimensional · AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · CAD = computer-aided design · CG = centre of gravity · EC-nnn = edge case found by a failure search · F-nnn = system function in the item definition · FLT-nnn = walker fault in sim/faults.yaml · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · RAC = risk assessment code, severity category plus probability level (e.g. 1C) · S3-nnn = 3D hazard scene (sim/scenes3d) · SF-nnn = walker failure-search family (sim/search) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-CAD-001 = the concept layouts document (cad/README.md); its drawing sheets are SUS-CAD-001-CL-nn · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
